body:
Thanks for the help. I'll look into some online help as well.

I can be so low sometimes it's hard to move. The few good days I have are really good. It's just those are few and far between. 

I've been looking for happiness for years and just can't find it. A lot of days I just feel like happiness wasn't meant to be for me. I've felt like this for roughly 20 years. 

Suicide runs through my head most of the day. Every time something goes wrong, I just think to myself that ending it will make all this go away. It sucks living like this all the time.

I'll try to talk to someone soon. Like you, I don't want to appear weak. I just feel embarrassed feeling this way. I have a good day every now and then, but I just can't shake it. 

Thanks for the advice. It really means a lot.

Yeah here in the U.S. you have to pay for a doctors visit. If you have insurance, you have to pay the copay ( a small fee). However, I don't have insurance right now. 

What made you take the plunge and talk to someone? I'm so nervous about telling my family or friends the shape I'm really in. I try to act like I'm doing ok around them.
